user.title: Calendar Alarm Clock Setup
user.description:
Would you like to automatically discover and offer to set up alarm clocks for all your calendars?

**Found {calendar_count} calendar(s)**

**Auto-discovery**: Automatically offers to set up alarm clocks for all calendars (can get spammy if you have many calendars).

**Manual setup**: Manually select which calendar to use for alarms.

data_description.auto_discover_calendars: If enabled, the integration will automatically discover calendars and offer to set them up

manual.title: Select Calendar
manual.description: Select the calendar to use for storing alarms. Make sure you have a calendar integration (like CalDAV) set up first.

data_description.calendar_entity: The calendar where alarm events will be stored

discovery_confirm.title: Set up Alarm Clock
discovery_confirm.description:
A calendar **{calendar}** was discovered. Would you like to use it as an alarm clock?

Alarms will be stored as calendar events.

auto_discovery_confirm.title: Enable Calendar Alarm Clock Auto-Discovery
auto_discovery_confirm.description:
Calendar Alarm Clock can automatically discover your calendars and offer to set them up as alarm clocks.

Would you like to enable auto-discovery?

**Note**: You can always add calendars manually later by searching for 'Calendar Alarm Clock' in integrations.

abort.already_configured: This calendar is already configured for alarm clock.
abort.no_calendars: No calendar entities found. Please set up a calendar integration first (e.g., CalDAV, Google Calendar).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the calendar.

data_description.default_snooze_duration: How long to snooze when user hits snooze (default: 9 minutes)
data_description.default_alarm_timeout: How long an alarm rings before timing out (default: 30 minutes)
data_description.default_max_snoozes: Maximum number of snoozes allowed (0 = infinite)
